description: Repeated copies of a non-ARQ C_PDU are delivered once; after its reception window has passed, the same C_PDU ID names a new C_PDU, which is delivered.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ (service type tx_mode 2, no confirmation) and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED with MTU 2048 (A-0041, A-0047). Every D_PDU is a single-segment type 7 from 0.0.1.3 to 0.0.1.2, address size 4, EOW 0, EOT 10, C_PDU ID 4, reception window 6 (3 s), DATA S_PDU SAP 9 to SAP 5. At 2000 two copies of the C_PDU with U_PDU "one" (a sender's repeats, A-0081): the first completes it and is delivered; the second is a copy of a delivered C_PDU within its window (deadline 2000 + 3000 = 5000) and is dropped (C-1078). No reception window timer runs, since nothing is incomplete. At 6000, after that window, a C_PDU with the same ID and size and U_PDU "two" is a new C_PDU (C-0327) and is delivered.
